uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.heroDescription: Home to some of the world's oldest and most prestigious universities. A degree from the UK is recognized globally.

usa.name: USA
usa.heroDescription: The dream destination for international students. Limitless opportunities and cutting-edge research.

canada.name: Canada
canada.heroDescription: High quality of life, welcoming environment, and excellent post-study work options.

australia.name: Australia
australia.heroDescription: Beautiful landscapes, laid-back culture, and a world-class education system.

germany.name: Germany
germany.heroDescription: Tuition-free education at public universities and a hub for engineering and technology.

france.name: France
france.heroDescription: Art, culture, and prestige. France offers a unique study experience in the heart of Europe.

china.name: China
china.heroDescription: A blend of ancient tradition and modern innovation with generous CSC scholarships.

netherlands.name: Netherlands
netherlands.heroDescription: Innovative teaching, English-taught programs, and an open, international society.

norway.name: Norway
norway.heroDescription: Spectacular nature, high standard of living, and strong Nordic academic research.

portugal.name: Portugal
portugal.heroDescription: Affordable living, sunny weather, and a welcoming atmosphere in historic European cities.

austria.name: Austria
austria.heroDescription: Quality public education in the heart of Europe with rich musical and cultural heritage.

belgium.name: Belgium
belgium.heroDescription: The heart of the EU, multicultural environment, and high-quality research universities.

south-korea.name: South Korea
south-korea.heroDescription: Leading technology, vibrant culture, GKS scholarships, and world-class universities.

malaysia.name: Malaysia
malaysia.heroDescription: World-class education at an affordable cost in a vibrant, multicultural setting.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.heroDescription: A bridge between East and West offering quality Bologna-recognized education and rich history.

cyprus.name: Cyprus
cyprus.heroDescription: Mediterranean climate, affordable English-taught tuition, and a safe European campus lifestyle.

latvia.name: Latvia
latvia.heroDescription: Affordable European education in the Schengen Zone with strong technical and business programs.
